name: Text lines
description: Text kept to its lines, as a task list keeps its rows: each title has the lines extension, 1, so it stays on one line and is cut with … at the room it has, which changes with the terminal's width, its font and the host's, so the program never cuts it. Each due date has it too, so a short badge never breaks and keeps its place. The note under them has 2: two rows at most, the last cut with …. Narrow the window to see them give way. A host draws one line with text-overflow; it clamps more with line-clamp, which Blitz doesn't draw yet, so in hottyterm the note shows whole.

Move the nightly backups to the new bucket, then check that last week's restore still works

components.text: The backups move first: the old bucket closes at the end of the month, and the restore check needs a quiet evening, since it reads every snapshot from last week back into a scratch volume before comparing them.
